english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for mental focus or concentration.
Use this when the mind means the ability to keep thoughts directed at something or to give something attention.

examples.english: My attention is very focused when I read.
examples.traditional: 我睇書嗰陣，注意力好集中。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 tai2 syu1 go2 zan6 zyu3 ji3 lik6 hou2 zaap6 zung1

examples.english: You need to keep your mind focused in class.
examples.traditional: 上堂嗰陣要集中注意力呀。
examples.jyutping: soeng6 tong4 go2 zan6 jiu3 zaap6 zung1 zyu3 ji3 lik6 aa3
